title: Bearing Housing
model_title: Pump Bearing Housing (Oil-Ring Lubricated, Radial + Duplex Thrust Bearings)

introduction.definition: A pump bearing housing (bearing frame) supports the shaft in a radial bearing and a thrust bearing set, holds the lubricating oil and keeps contaminants out. An oil ring riding on the shaft lifts oil from the sump onto the bearings; a constant-level oiler keeps the oil level right; bearing isolators seal the shaft openings.
applications: Fans, blowers and other overhung machines
key_points: Oil level ≈ centre of lowest ball
Isolators keep water and dust out
introduction.summary: A pump bearing housing holds the radial and thrust bearings that support the pump shaft, with an oil bath, oil ring, constant-level oiler and bearing isolators.

temperature.title: Heat comes from the bearings; oil carries it to the housing
temperature.description: Friction in the bearings (thrust bearings more) heats the oil; the oil ring spreads oil and the finned housing rejects heat to air. Typical limits: bearing housing ≈ 80–85 °C or ≈ 40 °C above ambient (check the maker/API 610 guidance). Correct oil level matters: too low starves the bearings, too high churns and overheats. Bearing isolators keep water and dust out — contamination is the leading cause of bearing failure.

script.narration: This module introduces the Bearing Housing.
A pump bearing housing (bearing frame) supports the shaft in a radial bearing and a thrust bearing set, holds the lubricating oil and keeps contaminants out.
An oil ring riding on the shaft lifts oil from the sump onto the bearings; a constant-level oiler keeps the oil level right; bearing isolators seal the shaft openings.
Typical applications include process pumps (API 610 OH/BB types); fans, blowers and other overhung machines.

video_tutorials.title: Bearing Housing — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Bearing Housing.
Check oiler level, temperature and vibration.
Change oil / sample for analysis.
Replace bearings and isolators.
Watch for bearing overheating: high temperature. Common cause: wrong oil level, wrong oil, over-greasing.
Watch for water contamination: milky oil, rust. Common cause: failed isolator, washdown.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
